name: The Pile
description: An 825 GiB diverse, English-language text corpus assembled from 22 sources, including academic, web, code, and literary text, for language-model training and evaluation.
citation: Gao, L., Biderman, S., Black, S., Golding, L., Hoppe, T., Foster, C., Phang, J., He, H., Thite, A., Nabeshima, N., Presser, S., & Leahy, C. (2020). The Pile: An 800GB Dataset of Diverse Text for Language Modeling. arXiv:2101.00027. https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.00027

license.identifier: Various / not a single SPDX license
license.notes: The Pile aggregates sources with varying rights and terms, so there is no single dataset-wide SPDX license. Consult the licensing and usage terms for each constituent source before use or redistribution. Access to hosted copies may be gated by the provider's terms.
